description.en-US: What an operator calls this set of gateway credentials, e.g. 'MoMo - Hanoi store'. Free text rather than an identifier: nothing keys on it, and two profiles for the same gateway are told apart by it in the picker.
The payment method this merchant account collects through. The method owns the gateway adapter; profiles only supply its credentials.

The gateway credentials, AES-256-GCM encrypted and hex-encoded. This is the only form that reaches the database. Callers never send or read it directly: they use the plain 'config' field, which the CRUD actions encrypt on the way in and decrypt on the way out, so a row read straight out of the table discloses nothing.
